text:
Ming: Hey team  two quick onboarding items before I start Monday: 1) My previous employer's COBRA runs until the day before my start  can benefits be backdated? 2) I paid for a short-term furnished suite and need to expense it; do I submit those as 'Temporary Housing' or part of the relocation lump? Also my direct deposit failed with SSO bank link error  who to contact?

Asha (People Ops): Welcome, Ming! :wave: Shortanswers: 1) You have a 30-day enrollment window to add coverage; we can request retroactive coverage to your start date in COBRA-gap cases (requires proof). 2) If your offer included an itemized relocation reimbursement, submit receipts under "Relocation" with line item "Temporary Housing"; if you were given a one-time taxable stipend, that'll be payroll. For the direct deposit SSO error, ping payroll with a secure upload.

Rafael (Benefits): Hi Ming  confirm: upload your COBRA termination date and any proof to the benefits portal and tag it "retro request". We'll review and, if eligible, escalate to the carrier. Please include the last-paycheck or COBRA invoice showing end date. If carrier approves, coverage can be backdated to your start date in many cases.

Ming: Thanks. For the furnished suite receipts I have a mix of PDFs and a credit card statement that aggregates charges  will that be accepted? Also, is there a cap on temporary housing per diem?

Rafael (Benefits): PDFs and itemized hotel folios are preferred. If your card statement is aggregated, include booking confirmation or a folio from the property showing line items. Policy: temporary housing is eligible up to policy limits in your offer (check your relocation doc). If unsure, put the full receipts in Expensely and choose "Relocation - Temporary Housing"; finance will review and apply the cap.

Tori (Payroll): For direct deposit SSO issues, do NOT email bank info. Use the payroll portal secure banking upload. If SSO link fails, open a secure ticket to payroll@redwood.example with subject "SECURE BANK - Ming - <offerID>" and include a screenshot of the error; we'll prioritize if it's before the 48h payroll cutoff. If needed, payroll can manually verify via secure doc upload.

Ming: Appreciate it. One more oddball Q: we celebrate Diwali regionally and I'd like to swap one US-observed holiday for that day  is that allowed?

Asha (People Ops): We allow regional holiday swaps with manager approval and People Ops recording the exception. Ask your manager to approve a "regional holiday swap" in the email and cc people-ops. We'll log the swap and it will appear in your PTO balance.

Ming: Sweet. Also my relocation receipts include a EUR payment and a USD payment  can I get the reimbursement in EUR?

Finance Bot: Expense received (TempHousing - Ming) ID: 448221. Currency: mixed (EUR, USD). Status: awaiting finance review.

Tori (Payroll): If we have an EU bank on file for you, finance can pay reimbursements in EUR. Otherwise we'll convert to USD at company FX rate on the payout date. In Expensely add note "EUR payout requested" and include your EUR bank details via secure payroll upload if you want EUR disbursement.

Ming: Got it. If COBRA retro isn't approved, what's the fallback for having no coverage for those days?

Rafael (Benefits): If retro is denied, you can enroll and coverage will start per standard effective date (1st of the month after 30 days). In the interim, we can discuss short-term bridge options (limited) or advise on purchasing a short-term individual plan; benefits can help price options. Let us know and we'll walk through carrier timelines.

Ming: Thanks everyone  I'll upload the required docs today and open a secure ticket for the bank upload. Ping me if you need anything else.

Asha (People Ops): Great  welcome to Redwood! We'll follow up once finance/benefits review completes. :raised_hands:
